title: Shar's Temptation

sources.title: Charmed
markers: removed if the creature is attacked

summary: Casts Charm Person once per Short Rest.

fields.Charm Person: Level 1, Action, 60 ft. One humanoid must pass a Wisdom save against spell save DC or be Charmed for 10 turns. It cannot attack you, and your Charisma checks in dialogue have advantage. Your harmful attack can end the effect.
fields.Acquisition: In the crate beside the ground-floor ladder.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
